issue.title: Work-spawn route ignores the per-issue workModel override — role default wins and then clobbers the record
acceptanceCriteria: Given a consent written with workModel 'k3', when readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel runs, then it returns 'k3'

Given a stored workModel 'k3', when writeAutoSpawnOnFinalizeFlag(issue, true) runs with no options, then a new generation is written and readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel still returns 'k3'; with { workModel: null } it returns undefined
Given a claimed consent with workModel 'k3', when completeAutoSpawnConsentClaim spends it, then readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel returns undefined
Given a granted consent with workModel 'k3', when withAutoSpawnConsentClaim runs its operation, then the operation receives a claim whose workModel equals 'k3'
Given a v2 record without workModel or a legacy { autoSpawnOnFinalize: true } record, when it is claimed, then the claim succeeds with workModel undefined
Given POST start-planning with { workModel: 'k3', autoStart: true }, when the handler runs, then spawnPlanningSession is called with workModel 'k3'
Given POST start-planning without workModel, when the handler runs, then spawnPlanningSession is called with workModel undefined and the consent generation it writes carries no workModel
Given a consent stored with workModel 'k3', when resolveAutoSpawnOnFinalize(true, issue) rewrites it, then readAutoSpawnConsentWorkModel still returns 'k3'
Given a body model ' gpt-5.6-sol ' and a consent model 'k3', when resolveWorkSpawnRequestedModel runs, then it returns 'gpt-5.6-sol'
Given no body model and a consent model 'k3', when resolveWorkSpawnRequestedModel runs, then it returns 'k3'; given '' or a non-string body model and no consent model it returns undefined

Given spawn.ts after the change, when `grep -n "explicitModel: string | null = requestedModel" src/dashboard/server/routes/agents/spawn.ts` runs, then it prints exactly one match, and `git grep -n resolveIssueWorkModel src/dashboard` prints nothing

Given a granted consent with workModel B and spawnAgent called with model A, startedBy 'planning-auto-handoff' and autoSpawnConsentRequired true, when it spawns, then the persisted agent state has model B

blocker.title: New-cycle consent write fails hard on an unreadable record
